definition: I. [ כָּבַר ] verb be much, many (Assyrian kabâru , be great, mighty ; kabru , great, huge ; Arabic be great , in body, rank, or age, great, noble, aged ; Ethiopic be honoured, magnified ; honoured, glorious ; Sabean epithet כבר Hal Et. Sab. JAs Dec. 1874, No. 90 ; Syriac , for Hebrew רָבָה , הִרְבָּה , (rare) much ; Zinjirli be abundant, numerous ) — Hiph`il (only Elihu) make many , Job 35:16 בִּבְלִי דַעַת מִלִּין יַכְבִּר (compare וְיֶרֶב אֲמָרָיו Job 34:37 ) > make great , Bu Beitr. 138 , comparing Job 8:2 מַכְבִּיר with the force of a substantive ( Ew § 160 c ) Job 36:31 לְמַכְֶבִּיר יתן אכל giveth food in abundance (= prose לָרֹב , e.g. 2Chr 11:23 ).

I. [כָּבַר] verb be much, many (Assyrian kabâru, be great, mighty; kabru, great, huge; Arabic be great, in body, rank, or age, great, noble, aged; Ethiopic be honoured, magnified; honoured, glorious; Sabean epithet כבר HalEt. Sab. JAs Dec. 1874, No. 90; Syriac , for Hebrew רָבָה, הִרְבָּה, (rare) much; Zinjirli be abundant, numerous) —

Hiph`il (only Elihu) make many, Job 35:16 בִּבְלִי דַעַת מִלִּין יַכְבִּר (compare וְיֶרֶב אֲמָרָיו Job 34:37) > make great, BuBeitr. 138, comparing Job 8:2 מַכְבִּיר with the force of a substantive (Ew§ 160 c) Job 36:31 לְמַכְֶבִּיר יתן אכל giveth food in abundance (= prose לָרֹב, e.g. 2Chr 11:23).
